status: Native backend implemented and independently tested; host UI integration pending

architecture.runtime: Native C++ QtCore worker pool and QProcess; system Git executable is an external deployment dependency. No Node or Electron.
architecture.api: GitService methods return request IDs, completed(id,GitResult) delivers immutable snapshots. WorktreeSetupRunner emits progress/final WorktreeSetupRun values.
architecture.serialization: Per-commonGitDir locks within each GitService; linked and regular worktrees of the same repository share one lock. No stale read cache. Host context is refreshed when a queued operation starts.
architecture.process_lifecycle: Windows children start suspended, join a kill-on-close Job Object, then resume. Timeouts/cancellation/output caps tear down descendants. No shell interpolation for Git commands.
architecture.path_scope: Host-opened/mounted exact roots and canonical managed worktrees only. Windows final-handle path resolution checks junctions and symlinks; paths cannot escape repository/managed roots.
architecture.mutation_result: mayHaveMutated is conservative once a mutation command was attempted. A successful mutation remains successful if refreshing the post-mutation snapshot fails, with an explicit warning. Host should refresh after failed/interrupted mutations too.

remaining_gaps: MainWindow workspace/chat detach, mount sequencing and per-repository Settings editor are not connected by this module.
The host must prevent a worktree from being mounted while its removal is in flight; the service cannot atomically control UI mounts or external Git processes.
Filesystem/ref refresh watchers and seven-day cleanup snooze persistence are host integration work. Calls always read fresh Git state.
Git working diff rejects symlink/junction file editing; binary bytes are retained but need a non-text presentation. Dedicated submodule diff rendering is not implemented.
Git itself removes ignored files during an otherwise clean worktree removal; this matches the pinned upstream Git policy and is exercised in a fixture.
Untracked-file line counting and diff results have explicit output/file limits; oversized content yields an error instead of silent truncation.
The current global worktrees.setupScript setting is not silently executed or migrated; upstream scripts belong to the selected repository.
Setup does not itself establish a workspace mount; only the host may call startAfterMount using metadata from a successful creation.
Only Windows process-tree ownership is implemented/tested. POSIX process-group lifecycle and macOS shell sessions remain unverified.
No exhaustive Git-version, filesystem, credential-helper, hook, submodule or remote-auth compatibility claim is made. Existing user Git configuration/hooks still apply to explicit Git actions.

third_party.runtime_dependency: System Git executable; no new managed runtime
